subject: math
title: Quadrilaterals: Squares, Rectangles, Rhombuses and More
seo_title: Grade 3 Quadrilaterals Worksheets: Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Trapezoid (Shared Attributes)
standard_text: Understand that shapes in different categories (e.g., rhombuses, rectangles, and others) may share attributes (e.g., having four sides), and that the shared attributes can define a larger category (e.g., quadrilaterals). Recognize rhombuses, rectangles, and squares as examples of quadrilaterals, and draw examples of quadrilaterals that do not belong to any of these subcategories.
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 quadrilaterals worksheets with pictures: what makes a quadrilateral, naming squares, rectangles, rhombuses, parallelograms and trapezoids, shared attributes, always/sometimes/never, and real-world shapes. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: A quadrilateral is a closed shape with 4 straight sides.
key_sub: Rectangle = 4 right angles. Rhombus = 4 equal sides. A square has both, so a square is also a rectangle and a rhombus. Turning a shape never changes its name.
body_html:
What is a quadrilateral?

A quadrilateral is a closed flat shape with 4 straight sides. It also has 4 vertices (corners) and 4 angles. Quad means 4. The sides can be any length, and the shape can be turned any way.

Read the marks

MarkWhat it means
Matching tick marks on sidesThose sides are the same length
A small square in a cornerA right angle (a square corner, like the corner of a book)
Matching arrows on sidesThose sides are parallel: they go the same way and never meet, like train tracks

Special quadrilaterals

ShapeWhat it must have
Rectangle4 right angles
Rhombus4 equal sides
Square4 right angles and 4 equal sides
Parallelogram2 pairs of parallel sides
Trapezoidexactly 1 pair of parallel sides
Shape4 sides4 right angles4 equal sides2 pairs of parallel sides
SquareYesYesYesYes
RectangleYesYesSometimesYes
RhombusYesSometimesYesYes
ParallelogramYesSometimesSometimesYes
TrapezoidYesNoNoNo

Some books say a trapezoid has at least one pair of parallel sides. Every trapezoid in this unit has exactly one pair, so both meanings agree.

One shape, many names

A square has 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. It has 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. Shapes in different groups can share attributes. When we ask for the best name, choose the one that tells the most.

Example

A shape has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. Which names fit?

4 right angles: rectangle. 4 equal sides: rhombus. Both: square. Square is the best name.

Answer: square, rectangle and rhombus

Quadrilaterals with no special name

Many quadrilaterals are not rectangles, rhombuses, or squares. To draw one, give it sides of different lengths and no right angles.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
A turned square is a diamond, not a squareCheck the marks: 4 equal sides and 4 right angles make a square in any position
A square is not a rectangleA rectangle needs only 4 right angles. Every square is a rectangle
Every rhombus is a squareA rhombus needs 4 equal sides. It is a square only with 4 right angles
Counting a shape with a curved side as a quadrilateralAll 4 sides must be straight, and the shape must be closed
Thinking all 4 sides of a quadrilateral must be equalAny closed shape with 4 straight sides counts

faq.a: Yes. A rectangle is any quadrilateral with 4 right angles, and every square has 4 right angles. A square is a special rectangle whose 4 sides are all equal.
Yes. A rhombus is a quadrilateral with 4 equal sides, and every square has 4 equal sides. A square is a rhombus that also has 4 right angles.

faq.q: What is a quadrilateral in 3rd grade math?
faq.a: A quadrilateral is a closed flat shape with 4 straight sides and 4 angles. Squares, rectangles, rhombuses, parallelograms and trapezoids are all quadrilaterals.

faq.q: What quadrilateral is not a rectangle, rhombus, or square?
faq.a: Any quadrilateral without 4 right angles and without 4 equal sides, such as a trapezoid, a kite shape with two different side lengths, or a shape with 4 different side lengths.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 5 sides. The other three shapes all have 4 straight sides, so they are quadrilaterals.

items.q: How many angles does a quadrilateral have?
items.e: A quadrilateral has 4 vertices, and there is an angle at each one: 4 angles.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: The two ends do not meet, so the shape is not closed. A quadrilateral must be a closed shape.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Touch each side as you count: 5 sides. It is a pentagon.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: It has 6 sides, so it is a hexagon, not a quadrilateral.

items.q: Kai drew a closed shape with 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are different lengths. Is it a quadrilateral?
c: Only if it is a square
items.e: Any closed shape with 4 straight sides is a quadrilateral. The sides can be different lengths and the angles can be any size.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape B has a curved side. The other three shapes have 4 straight sides, so they are quadrilaterals.

items.q: How many sides does every quadrilateral have?
items.e: Quad means 4. Every quadrilateral has 4 straight sides, 4 vertices and 4 angles.

items.q: Which shape is a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 4 straight sides and is closed, even though it is turned. The others have 6 sides, an open gap or 3 sides.

items.q: Which shape is a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 4 straight sides and is closed. The others have 3 sides, 5 sides or a curved side.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: Count the sides: 4 straight sides, and the shape is closed. A quadrilateral can have a corner that points in.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: Count carefully: it has 5 sides, so it is a pentagon, not a quadrilateral.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: It has only 3 sides and 3 vertices. A quadrilateral needs 4 sides.

items.q: How many angles does this shape have?
items.e: There is one angle at each vertex. 6 vertices means 6 angles.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: It is closed and has 4 straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral. Turning a shape does not change how many sides it has.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and is closed. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: Is this shape a quadrilateral?
items.e: One side is curved. A quadrilateral has 4 straight sides, so this shape is not one.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: It has 3 sides, so it is a triangle, not a quadrilateral.

items.q: How many vertices (corners) does this shape have?
items.e: A vertex is a corner where two sides meet. This shape has 4 vertices.

items.q: Which of these is NOT a quadrilateral?
items.e: A triangle has 3 sides. Squares, rhombuses and trapezoids all have 4 sides.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. There are no right-angle marks, so it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: Opposite sides are equal (and parallel), but there are no right angles and the sides are not all equal. It is a parallelogram, not a rectangle or a rhombus.

items.q: On a drawing, what does a small square in a corner show?
items.e: A small square in a corner marks a right angle, a square corner like the corner of a book. Tick marks show equal sides, and arrows show parallel sides.

items.q: A quadrilateral has 4 equal sides but no right angles. What is its best name?
items.e: 4 equal sides make it a rhombus. With no right angles, it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. There are no right-angle marks, so it is not a square. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: On a drawing, what do matching tick marks on two sides show?
items.e: Sides with the same number of tick marks are the same length.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: Opposite sides are equal (and parallel), but there are no right angles and the sides are not all equal. It is a parallelogram, not a rectangle or a rhombus. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The small squares show 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. The tick marks show that only opposite sides are equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The arrows show exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other two sides are not parallel, so it is a trapezoid.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The small squares show 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. The tick marks show that only opposite sides are equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, and the small squares show 4 right angles. That makes it a square. It is also a rectangle and a rhombus, but square is the best name because it tells the most. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. What is it called?
items.e: Exactly one pair of parallel sides: that is a trapezoid. Parallelograms, rectangles and rhombuses have 2 pairs.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, and the small squares show 4 right angles. That makes it a square. It is also a rectangle and a rhombus, but square is the best name because it tells the most. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The arrows show exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other two sides are not parallel, so it is a trapezoid.

items.q: A quadrilateral has 4 right angles. Its opposite sides are equal, but its sides are not all the same length. What is its best name?
items.e: 4 right angles make it a rectangle. The sides are not all equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. There are no right-angle marks, so it is not a square. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, and the small squares show 4 right angles. That makes it a square. It is also a rectangle and a rhombus, but square is the best name because it tells the most.

items.q: A quadrilateral has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. What is its best name?
items.e: 4 equal sides and 4 right angles: that is a square. (It is also a rectangle and a rhombus, but square tells the most.)

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The small squares show 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. The tick marks show that only opposite sides are equal, so it is not a square. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the best name for this shape? Use the marks.
items.e: The arrows show exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other two sides are not parallel, so it is a trapezoid. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: How many sides of a rhombus are the same length?
items.e: A rhombus is a quadrilateral with 4 equal sides.

items.q: What does every square have that not every rhombus has?
items.e: Every rhombus already has 4 equal sides. A square is a rhombus that also has 4 right angles.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: The marks show right angles at 2 corners only. The other 2 angles are not right angles.

items.q: What do shape A and shape B both have?
items.e: Both are quadrilaterals with 4 sides. Only the rectangle has right angles, and only the rhombus has 4 equal sides.

items.q: Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
items.e: Shape D has arrows on only one pair of sides. The others have arrows on 2 pairs of sides.

items.q: Which attribute do a square and a rhombus always share?
items.e: Both have 4 equal sides. A square also has 4 right angles, but most rhombuses do not.

items.q: Which shape has 4 equal sides?
items.e: Shape B has the same tick mark on all 4 sides. The others have 2 pairs of equal sides, not 4 equal sides.

items.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a parallelogram have?
items.e: A parallelogram has 2 pairs of parallel sides: top and bottom, and left and right. (4 is the number of sides, not pairs.)

items.q: Which attribute does every quadrilateral have?
items.e: Every quadrilateral has 4 sides. Right angles, equal sides and parallel sides belong only to some quadrilaterals.

items.q: Which attribute do a square and a rectangle always share?
items.e: Both have 4 right angles. A square also has 4 equal sides, but most rectangles do not.

items.q: A closed shape has 4 straight sides, and all 4 sides are the same length. Which name must fit it?
items.e: 4 equal sides is all a rhombus needs. It is a square only if it also has 4 right angles, and we do not know that.

items.q: What does every rectangle have that not every parallelogram has?
items.e: All parallelograms have 2 pairs of parallel sides and 4 vertices. A rectangle is the kind with 4 right angles.

items.q: Which shape has 4 right angles?
items.e: Shape C has a right-angle mark in all 4 corners. One shape has only 2 right angles, and the others have none.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: All 4 corners have the right-angle mark. Every rectangle has 4 right angles, even when it is turned.

items.q: What do shape A and shape B both have?
items.e: Both shapes have right-angle marks in all 4 corners. Only the square has 4 equal sides.

items.q: What does every square have that not every rectangle has?
items.e: Every rectangle already has 4 right angles. A square is a rectangle that also has 4 equal sides.

items.q: How many right angles does every rectangle have?
items.e: A rectangle is a quadrilateral with 4 right angles. That is what makes it a rectangle.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: Only one corner has the right-angle mark. The other 3 angles are bigger or smaller than a right angle.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: There are no right-angle marks. A rhombus has 4 equal sides, but its angles are not right angles unless it is a square.

items.q: What do shape A and shape B both have?
items.e: Both shapes have the same tick mark on all 4 sides. Only the square has right angles.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A square has 4 right angles.
items.e: Every square has 4 right angles, even when it is turned to look like a diamond.

items.q: Ben says a square is not a rectangle because a rectangle must have 2 long sides and 2 short sides. Is he right?
c: Yes, a square is a rhombus
No, a square has 4 right angles
Yes, its sides are all equal
items.e: A rectangle only needs 4 right angles. A square has 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle with all sides equal.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A rectangle is a quadrilateral.
items.e: Every rectangle is a closed shape with 4 straight sides, so it is always a quadrilateral.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A rhombus is a square.
items.e: Only a rhombus with 4 right angles is a square. Most rhombuses have no right angles.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A triangle is a quadrilateral.
items.e: A triangle has 3 sides. A quadrilateral has 4 sides, so a triangle is never a quadrilateral.

items.q: Ava says this shape is a square because all 4 sides are equal. Is she right?
c: Yes, it is a turned square
No, it has no right angles
No, its sides are not equal
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. A square also needs 4 right angles, and this shape has none.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A quadrilateral is a rhombus.
items.e: Only a quadrilateral with 4 equal sides is a rhombus. Many quadrilaterals have sides of different lengths.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A shape with a curved side is a quadrilateral.
items.e: A quadrilateral has 4 straight sides. A shape with a curved side is never a quadrilateral.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A parallelogram has 4 right angles.
items.e: A parallelogram has 4 right angles only when it is a rectangle. Most parallelograms lean and have no right angles.

items.q: Kim says this shape is not a square because it is turned. Is she right?
c: Yes, it is a rhombus only
items.e: The marks show 4 equal sides and 4 right angles, so it is a square. Turning a shape never changes its name. (It is also a rhombus.)

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A square is a rectangle.
items.e: A rectangle needs 4 right angles. Every square has 4 right angles, so every square is a rectangle, even when it is turned.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A square is a rhombus.
items.e: A rhombus needs 4 equal sides. Every square has 4 equal sides, so every square is a rhombus. Turning does not matter.

items.q: A rhombus has 4 right angles. Which is true?
c: It is not a rhombus now
items.e: 4 equal sides and 4 right angles make a square. It is still a rhombus, and it is also a rectangle.

items.q: Every rhombus is also a ___.
items.e: A rhombus has 4 straight sides, so it is always a quadrilateral. It is a square or a rectangle only when it has 4 right angles.

items.q: Which names fit every square?
items.e: A square has 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle. It has 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. It is both.

items.q: A rectangle has 4 equal sides. Which is true?
items.e: 4 right angles and 4 equal sides make a square. It is also a rhombus, and it is still a quadrilateral.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A rectangle is a square.
items.e: Only a rectangle with 4 equal sides is a square. A rectangle 6 cm by 3 cm is not a square.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A rhombus has 4 right angles.
items.e: A rhombus has 4 right angles only when it is a square. Most rhombuses have no right angles.

items.q: Every rectangle is also a ___.
items.e: A rectangle has 2 pairs of parallel sides, so it is always a parallelogram. It is a square or a rhombus only when its sides are all equal.

items.q: Is this true always, sometimes, or never? A rectangle has 4 equal sides.
items.e: Only a rectangle that is a square has 4 equal sides. Most rectangles have 2 long sides and 2 short sides.

items.q: A toy kite has 2 sides that are 30 cm long and 2 sides that are 50 cm long. Is it a rhombus?
c: No, its sides are not all equal
Yes, it looks like a diamond
items.e: A rhombus needs 4 equal sides. This kite has two 30 cm sides and two 50 cm sides. It is a quadrilateral, but not a rhombus.

items.q: Which quadrilateral is NOT a rectangle, a rhombus, or a square?
items.e: Shape B is a kite shape. Its sides come in 2 pairs of different lengths and it has no right angles. The others are a rhombus, a square and a rectangle.

items.q: The bases on a baseball field make a shape with 4 equal sides of 90 feet and 4 right angles. People call it a diamond. What is its best name?
items.e: 4 equal sides and 4 right angles make a square. It looks like a diamond only because it is turned.

items.q: Which quadrilateral is NOT a rectangle, a rhombus, or a square?
items.e: Shape B is a trapezoid. It has no right angles and its sides are not all equal. The others are a square, a rectangle and a rhombus.

items.q: Why is this kite shape not a rhombus?
c: Its sides are not all equal
items.e: The tick marks show 2 short equal sides and 2 long equal sides. A rhombus needs all 4 sides equal. A rhombus does not need right angles.

items.q: A floor tile has 4 sides, and each side is 8 inches long. Its corners are not right angles. What is its best name?
items.e: 4 equal sides make a rhombus. Without right angles, it is not a square.

items.q: Leo draws a quadrilateral with exactly 1 right angle. Which of these names can it have?
items.e: Rectangles and squares need 4 right angles. If a rhombus has 1 right angle, all 4 of its angles are right angles. So a shape with exactly 1 right angle is none of these.

items.q: Zoe cuts one corner off a square piece of paper with one straight cut. How many sides does the paper have now?
items.e: The cut takes away 1 corner but adds 1 new side and 2 new corners: 4 + 1 = 5 sides. It is now a pentagon, not a quadrilateral.

items.q: A window has 4 right angles. The top and bottom are 4 feet long, and the sides are 2 feet long. Which name does NOT fit?
items.e: It has 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. Its sides are not all equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: No sides are equal, no sides are parallel, and there are no right angles. What is the best name for this shape?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral. With no parallel sides it is not a trapezoid or a parallelogram, and with no equal sides it is not a rhombus.

items.q: A slice of pizza has 2 straight sides and a curved crust. Is it a quadrilateral?
items.e: A quadrilateral has 4 straight sides. The pizza slice has a curved side, and only 3 sides in all.

items.q: A picture frame has 4 sides of 10 inches and 4 right angles. Which names fit it?
items.e: 4 right angles make it a rectangle, 4 equal sides make it a rhombus, and both together make it a square. All three names fit.

items.q: Why is this rhombus not a square?
items.e: The tick marks show 4 equal sides, but a square also needs 4 right angles. This shape has none.

items.q: Why is this shape not a rectangle?
items.e: A rectangle needs 4 right angles. This parallelogram has none. Turning or size never decides a shape's name.

items.q: A triangle-shaped sign is cut straight across, parallel to its bottom edge. What shape is the bottom piece?
items.e: The bottom piece has 4 sides. The cut and the bottom edge are parallel, but the two slanted sides are not. Exactly one pair of parallel sides makes a trapezoid.

items.q: Which quadrilateral is NOT a rectangle, a rhombus, or a square?
items.e: Shape A has 4 different side lengths and no right angles. The others are a rectangle, a rhombus and a square.

items.q: A door is 7 feet tall and 3 feet wide. It has 4 right angles. What is its best name?
items.e: 4 right angles make a rectangle. The sides are not all equal, so it is not a square.

items.q: Why is this shape not a rhombus?
c: Its sides are not all equal
items.e: A rhombus needs 4 equal sides. This rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. (A rhombus can have right angles: a square does.)

items.q: Mia wants to draw a quadrilateral that is not a rectangle, a rhombus, or a square. Which plan works?
items.e: With 4 different side lengths it cannot be a rhombus or a square. A rectangle needs opposite sides equal, so it is not a rectangle either.

items.q: A stop sign has 8 sides. Is it a quadrilateral?
items.e: A quadrilateral has exactly 4 sides. A stop sign has 8 sides, so it is an octagon.
